title: Rehearsal requires two different authorities
when: Before first rehearsal, especially on Yoke Cloud
need: The item/lease/receipt belongs to its control plane; migration code runs on a separate validation DB. Current rehearse command requires local-Postgres/db-admin access to the item universe and refuses HTTPS. If unavailable, it directs the user to the control-plane operator.
surface: migration rehearse help; databases lines 15 and capability validation-binding reference.
gap: Major adoption boundary: hosted users cannot self-serve this with application DB credentials. Proposed discovery must disclose the limit before governance is accepted; the end-to-end external-user provisioning path remains to be designed/verified.
review: The provisioning recipe activates and leases the admin tunnel, then passes its DSN through the source runner, which preserves the successful copy's binding outside its disposable machine home; end-to-end external-user provisioning remains unverified.
recipes: yoke dev db-admin exec <admin-env> --dsn-var YOKE_PG_DSN -- yoke dev run -- python3 -m runtime.api.tools.authority_validation_copy
